availability.caveat: lastUpdated is the Desk's last write, not a stated publication time: the Desk states no clock time for its results, and the reading assumes the API serves a record from the time it is written, which cannot be verified from outside
availability.rule: a date's figure is public at the decision instant of its own day when the latest lastUpdated of its records is at or before 18:00 New York on that day; a date written later (or rewritten later) is withheld and reads as no take-up

label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the candidate of avenue #1318 and (s3c) the H5 candidate until she rules.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and take-up splits beside it.

Whether the same-day reading enters a published declaration, or the arm goes back to her as a candidate, is a marked question with numbered options and a default that changes no claim; the registry is not changed in this directive.
